Bucket(rate, burst) is a token bucket that starts full with burst tokens and refills at rate tokens per second, never holding more than burst. allow(now, cost=1) first adds the tokens earned since the previous call, using the float timestamp now (calls never go backwards in time), then returns True and removes cost tokens when at least cost tokens are present, or returns False and removes nothing. The clock starts at 0. Fractions of a token accumulate. Examples are Python. With b = Bucket(1, 2); b.allow(0); b.allow(0), b.allow(0) is False.
